FactoryAction.description: Exact product permissions. Runtime authority remains a separate product fact.

FactoryApiRequest.description: Canonical C09 route input. `path` is populated from trusted routing state. Tenant identity is intentionally absent, and resource identity never appears in a request body.

FactoryArtifactReference.description: Opaque, immutable object reference. Ownership is resolved by the gateway.

FactoryMutationPreconditions.description: Values sourced from Idempotency-Key and If-Match, outside the JSON body.

payloadDigest.description: Canonical path/query/body digest computed by the shared route wrapper.

packageLock.description: Immutable runner package and optional model configuration approved for release.

nodeId.description: Root of the bounded node subtree to replace.

FactoryRunStartBody.description: Parameters are named factory input ports. Large values use artifact handles.

expiresAtMs.description: Whole-second expiry, no more than one hour after issuance.

scopes.description: Canonical order is read, write, chat.
